caption: The drawing depicts a single, stylized animal figure resembling a crocodile or lizard, rendered in shades of brown and gray with some darker spots. The creature has an elongated body and tail, four legs, and a wide-open mouth with conspicuous, pointed white teeth. Emerging from its mouth is a curved, snake-like object with greenish coloring at the tip, appearing as if being bitten or eaten. The animal's long tail curls upward and loops above its back in an exaggerated, twisting shape. The figure stands on a rectangular base, which is similarly colored in brown and gray tones. The background of the image is plain and off-white, with no other objects or features present.
title: Dragon and Serpent Weather Vane
